note: In the ledger, `sources` holds indices into `sources` below, and method fields hold indices into `methods`.
methods: Pin unresolved_baseline.jsonl and later identity events. Retained baseline unresolved counts: EE 5, SI 213, SK 86. Later PR 2063 classification events resolve 3 EE and 195 SI keys. SK has no subsequent identity event. No unresolved key changes in this delivery; no new identity events.

No population/year changes to any held row. EE BY-SA excluded by owner allowlist; SI unnamed attribution permission fails owner named-licence gate; LT licence passes but access-block response prevents count use; LV counts retained as candidates but national geometry downloads timed out. Source failures are not absence evidence.

Latest same-entity municipal count: MAN10001 Q2 2026 at 30 June, publisher-rounded: tens above 50 and fives at 50 or below; MAN02005 at 1 January 2026 only where Q2 names a successor rather than this entity. Exact official name plus municipal timeline code, current own municipality P31, own label, row/state name or ISO code, both points in date-valid national polygon. Post-original municipal codes held as potential successors.

Same entity only. Require own literal Wikidata claims, own municipality code (SK P782) or exact Icelandic official municipality name and timeline code, compatible scope, same state, original record point and own-item point inside the same official boundary. Original unresolved keys stay held; no decision_only event on a changed row.

All admitted reference dates are latest available dates in the captured official tables for that same entity. No stored population_year is newer. Inspect own-item dated P1082 for a newer stored official value; do not equate a higher undated number to a more recent same-entity estimate.

Only population and population_year may change. Per-field before presence/value, full canonical row hashes, exact changed-data-file bytes and exact provenance-file bytes are guarded. Later Git commits with identical guarded inputs are accepted.

STATdata om7101mr: TOTAL sex, UNIT_PERS, U_OM_0057 end-of-period population, 2026, month 7. Complete published catalogue of 1,424 cubes inspected; July 2026 is latest municipal population period. Exact own P782 equals e_nuts15 acronym; six-digit suffix equals national INSPIRE AU nationalCode. Official municipality-district-region hierarchy and own P131 state path both checked. Urban parts also require recorded parent_id equal own P131 item. Published district qualifier accepted only when equal to the polygon official district name.

Iceland timeline geometries are used in original EPSG:4326. For invalid rings, standard Shapely make_valid is only a diagnostic: admit if it produces valid topology, relative area difference is below 1e-12 and both original and repaired geometries give identical containment for both points. No geometry, point or boundary is written to the repository. Larger differences remain held.
Latest same-entity official municipal total: Q2 2026, or January 2026 only when Q2 denotes a named successor rather than this original municipality.
